_comment: Orderflow Doctrine Monitor thresholds [st-2n69]. All values tunable; every emitted event records the threshold that fired it. Units: flow fields are $MM per GexBot; spot/walls are SPX points.

fields._comment: API fields backing each pane at expiry=latest (0DTE). Verified 2026-08-07: bottom pane is zcvr NOT ocvr (ocvr is all-expiry and diverges completely); wall lines are zero_mcall/zero_mput from the same response. cvroflow/gexoflow have no expiry prefix (only one_* variants exist).

spike._comment: A print is a spike when |x| exceeds max(abs_floor, pctl_mult * P95 of |last window_pulls prints|). Warmup: no spike events until window has min_warmup prints.

two_signal._comment: Brake (cvr up-spike) and gex spike within max_gap_pulls of each other (checklist pattern 3). Trend direction = sign of spot change over trend_lookback_pulls.

netcvx._comment: ocvr regime, hysteresis in $MM. DUMP starts when drop from rolling max (over lookback) exceeds dump_drop; ends when recovered dump_clear off the post-dump min. RAMP is the mirror. VTURN emits when, while in DUMP, ocvr rises vturn_rise off the min within vturn_pulls.

walls._comment: WALL_MOVE when the effective level shifts >= move_pts AND the new level persists persist_pulls consecutive pulls (the raw series blips for single pulls, e.g. 7735->7755->7735 on 2026-08-07). Inversion and SPOT_CROSS use the debounced effective levels; cross_hysteresis_pts avoids flutter at the line.

runtime._comment_rth: rth_utc clips processing to regular trading hours (UTC); pre-market pulls carry session-start artifacts (e.g. gexoflow 11490 prints at 00:00 CT).
